anomalies.observed: The AVR-ISP-6 header J4 has its MISO pin connected to the PWM global label and its MOSI pin connected to the SDA global label. The MCU symbols show PWM on PB1 and SDA on PB0.
anomalies.expected: For an ATtiny ISP header, MISO should be connected to the MCU MISO pin (PB0 on ATtiny45/13, the SDA net here) and MOSI to the MCU MOSI pin (PB1 on ATtiny45, the PWM net here; PB2 on ATtiny13). The drawing swaps these programming signals.

anomalies.impact: An ISP programmer plugged into J4 would drive/read the wrong MCU SPI pins, so in-system programming would fail and could conflict with the I2C/PWM nets.
